name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme by Ministry of MSME to generate continuous and sustainable self-employment opportunities in rural and urban areas.
target_group: Any individual above 18 years, SHGs, Co-operative societies, Producer groups. Special category: SC, ST, OBC, Women, Ex-Servicemen, Differently-abled.
loan_available: Up to 90-95% of project cost (Bank loan + Subsidy)
margin_requirement: 10% for General category, 5% for Special category (SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD)
interest_notes: Normal commercial bank lending rate (typically 8.5% - 11.5% p.a.)
collateral_notes: No collateral security required up to ₹10 Lakhs under CGTMSE guarantee cover
application_route: Online application via KVIC e-Portal (www.kviconline.gov.in) -> District Task Force Committee -> Bank Branch
documents: Educational qualification certificate (for project > ₹10L manufacturing / > ₹5L service)
Rural area certificate signed by Gram Pradhan / Revenue authority

name: PM MUDRA Yojana - Shishu
description: Micro-credit support for small micro-enterprises at nascent or starting stages requiring minimal capital.
target_group: Rural and urban micro-entrepreneurs, small artisans, petty shopkeepers, repair shops, small vendors.
subsidy_available: No capital subsidy; low interest rate subvention may apply under specific state norms
interest_notes: 8.5% - 10.0% p.a. depending on lending institution and RBI guidelines
collateral_notes: Zero collateral. Covered under Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU)
application_route: Direct application at nearest Commercial Bank, RRB, Small Finance Bank, or Udyamimitra portal
documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Driving License)
Proof of Residence (Ration Card / Utility Bill)
Business establishment quotation or simple quotation for tools/equipment

name: PM MUDRA Yojana - Kishore
description: Mid-tier micro finance for businesses that have already started operations or require established equipment and working capital.
target_group: Micro units expanding machinery, inventory, or starting standard small rural units.
subsidy_available: No capital subsidy; credit guarantee protection
interest_notes: 9.0% - 11.5% p.a. based on credit score and bank discretion
collateral_notes: No third-party collateral or personal guarantee required up to ₹10 Lakhs
application_route: Bank Branch, MUDRA portal (udyamimitra.in), or Jan Samarth Portal (jansamarth.in)
documents: Proof of business address & registration (Udyam Registration)
Projected sales / cash flow estimates for 1 year

name: PM MUDRA Yojana - Tarun
description: High-tier micro credit support for established rural & semi-urban enterprises scaling operations and procurement.
target_group: Mature micro units, small manufacturers, processing hubs seeking growth capital.
subsidy_available: No direct capital subsidy; supported by National Credit Guarantee
collateral_notes: Hypothecation of assets created out of bank loan; no third-party collateral required
application_route: Scheduled Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), Jan Samarth portal
documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with 3-year cash flow forecast
Last 2 years ITR or sales register (if existing business)
Machinery proforma invoices from verified vendors

name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME)
description: Centrally sponsored scheme under MoFPI to provide financial, technical and business support for upgrading existing micro food processing units and creating new units under One District One Product (ODOP) approach.
target_group: Individual micro food processing entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs, Producer Co-operatives.
loan_available: Credit-linked capital subsidy up to 35% of eligible project cost with max ceiling ₹10 Lakh per unit
interest_notes: Standard agricultural / food processing MSME lending rate (8.5% - 10.5% p.a.)
collateral_notes: Covered under CGTMSE for loans up to ₹2 Crore
application_route: PMFME Online Portal (pmfme.mofpi.gov.in) with assistance from District Resource Persons (DRP)

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Promotes entrepreneurship among women and SC/ST communities for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading sector.
target_group: SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs above 18 years of age setting up greenfield (first-time) ventures.
loan_available: Composite loan (term loan + working capital) covering 75% to 85% of project cost
subsidy_available: State-specific subsidies may be converged; no central capital subsidy
margin_requirement: 15% (can be converged with eligible state subsidy schemes)
interest_notes: Lowest applicable rate of the bank for that category (Base rate / MCLR + 3% + tenor premium)
collateral_notes: Secured by collateral or Credit Guarantee Scheme for Stand Up India Loans (CGFSIL)
application_route: Online portal (www.standupmitra.in) or directly through Lead District Manager (LDM) / Bank branch
documents: SC/ST certificate or proof of Women entrepreneur (51% minimum shareholding)
Pollution clearance / Panchayat NOC if applicable

name: DAY-NRLM (SHG Bank Linkage & Community Investment Support)
description: Poverty alleviation program by Ministry of Rural Development facilitating affordable credit, capacity building, and revolving funds to women Self Help Groups (SHGs) and rural micro-enterprises.
target_group: Rural women organized into SHGs, Village Organizations (VO), and individual members of SHGs.
loan_available: Subsidized term loans and revolving cash credit up to ₹6 Lakhs per SHG / member unit
subsidy_available: Interest subvention to bring effective borrowing rate down to 7% p.a. (additional 3% prompt repayment subvention in select districts)
interest_notes: Effective 4% - 7% p.a. with prompt repayment incentive
collateral_notes: No collateral or third-party guarantee required for loans up to ₹10-20 Lakhs to SHGs
application_route: Block Mission Management Unit (BMMU) / Gram Panchayat Cluster Coordinator -> Bank Branch

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: Comprehensive scheme by Ministry of MSME to support traditional artisans and craftspeople engaged in 18 traditional trades with collateral-free enterprise credit, skill upgrading, and digital transaction incentives.
target_group: Traditional artisans and craftsmen (Tailors/Darzi, Potter/Kumhaar, Blacksmith/Lohar, Basket weaver, Carpenter/Suthar, etc.)
loan_available: Tranche 1: Up to ₹1,00,000 (18 months); Tranche 2: Up to ₹2,00,000 (30 months)
subsidy_available: ₹15,000 tool kit incentive + 5% interest subvention by GoI + ₹1 per digital transaction incentive (up to 100/month)
interest_notes: Concessional 5% p.a. fixed interest rate for the beneficiary (GoI provides 8% subvention to lending bank)
collateral_notes: 100% collateral-free credit backed by National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company (NCGTC)
application_route: Common Service Centre (CSC) portal (pmvishwakarma.gov.in) -> Gram Panchayat verification -> Screening Committee
documents: Aadhaar Card linked with mobile number
